points.description: Identifies the missing term as water application efficiency (efficiency of water application / irrigation application efficiency), i.e. the efficiency relating water stored in the root zone to water delivered to the field.
points.partial_credit: 1 mark for a related but incomplete or different irrigation efficiency (e.g. just 'irrigation efficiency', 'water use efficiency', or 'field efficiency').

rubric.notes: Full marks for naming water application efficiency in any close wording (e.g. 'application efficiency', 'irrigation application efficiency'). Give 1 mark if the answer names a related irrigation efficiency (conveyance, distribution, use, or just 'irrigation efficiency') that is on the right track but not the exact one. Give 0 for unrelated answers.
